_comment: epeters.ca site chrome. build.js renders the top bar and footer line from this file; edit here, never in the pages. {section} is filled per page (blog, play, apps, quizzes, projects, home).
_barPages: Hand-built pages that get the top bar. Games, quizzes and calculators keep their own header (their layouts are full-screen or have back links); the blog gets the menu from essay-page.js.
_newsletterAlias: Email-list tag per section when it differs from the section name. The blog moved from /writing/ to /blog/ (#367); its sign-ups keep the epeters-writing tag until Elvin says otherwise.
_noChrome: Files that are inputs to the build (post bodies), not pages.
